Subject: Functional integration path, SDK changes & next steps

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and we can convert this into a short technical plan for your eng and procurement teams. I kept this tight so we can action items tomorrow.

Top pain & goal summary (as we heard it)
- Pain: current triage assistant has 2.0s+ token-level latency under load and no predictable burst capacity during peak clinical hours.
- Goal: move to sub-500ms tail latency for short prompts, enable streaming for progressive UI updates, and add a robust reranking layer for diagnostic suggestions.
- Security: needs to run in a VPC on Dedicated nodes with audit logging and KMS integration.

Key technical gaps we discussed (proposed fit)
1) Streaming & progressive responses — we recommend Redwood streaming with prefix caching to keep latency tight for short prompts. We will validate with a 5-minute load test.
2) Function calling mapping — Novamed has structured EHR actions (create-note, flag-alert). We'll propose a function schema and a fallback text path for unsupported actions.
3) Embeddings + rerank — propose an initial embedding index (64-dense) with an online reranker step to improve top-3 precision.
4) SDK changes — small surface changes to the client to support streaming chunk events and function-call schema validation. We estimate a 2-week internal sprint for a stable SDK build, plus 1 week of integration support.

Proposed next steps (owners & timing)
- Rishi to share solution worksheet and a one-page integration map (attached). ACTION: Rishi — by EOD today.
- Ben to draft SDK change checklist and effort estimate. ACTION: Ben — by Thursday 5/20.
- Sanjay / Priya to share sample telemetry (latency histograms) and procurement constraints. ACTION: Sanjay — by Friday 5/21.
- Schedule a 30-min tech validation session with your engs to walk the function mappings. ACTION: Rishi to propose times.

Attachments: redwood-solution-worksheet.pdf (integration map + proposed SLA options)

If this looks right, I will: 1) lock the technical assumptions into a short statement of work (PSA), and 2) spin up a short-lived dedicated canary for a 48-hour smoke test.

Thanks —

Thanks Rishi — this aligns with our notes. Two quick clarifications from our side:

- Priority: Streaming + deterministic function calls are top priority for the pilot. Reranking is next (we want measurable lift in top-3 diagnostic suggestions).
- Procurement: we need a simplified pricing option for a 3-month POC (includes limited dedicated capacity + data plane audit logs). Would you be able to provide a PO-ready estimate?
- Data sample: attaching a small latency histogram and a redacted sample of the prompt/response shapes (will send via separate secure link).

A couple of asks:
- Can the SDK support an explicit "function-call-type" field so we can map to our EHR adapter?
- For the canary, can you guarantee a rollback window of 30 minutes to our previous endpoint? (we need that for on-call coverage)

If you (and Ben) can respond to those two points, we can aim to sign the PSA next week.

--

Rishi / Kim — internal notes and quick engineering headers below. Sharing so we have an alignment doc before we reply to Sanjay.

Technical notes (SDK / runtime):
- Streaming: we can reuse the continuous-chunk API (v2) but need to add a small client-side backpressure hint to avoid UI jitter. Estimated effort: 3 dev-days + 1 QA day.
- Function schema: propose a compact JSON schema (action, params, confidence) and a strict validation layer in the SDK. Add a compatibility flag for older EHR adapters. Effort: 4 dev-days.
- Rerank: we suggest a two-stage pipeline: cheap ANN candidate fetch (prod index) -> lightweight transformer reranker at top-10. Will require adding a small reranker container to Dedicated pool for low-latency scoring. Ops impact: +0.5 GPUs for pilot.
- Rollback guarantee: we can provide automated traffic switch with a warm-fallback pool. 30-minute rollback window is feasible if we reserve canary routing and pre-warm caches. Ops note: need to confirm pre-warm cost in the PSA.

Action items (internal owners)
- Ben: produce SDK change checklist + engineering estimate (deliverable: github PR template + checklist). ETA: Thu 5/20 EOD.
- Kim: security & compliance checklist for Dedicated + KMS integration, and confirm audit-log retention options. ETA: Fri 5/21 EOD.
- Rishi: finalize PSA draft and pricing options for a 3-month POC. ETA: Mon 5/24.

I'll draft the technical appendix for the PSA and drop into the drive folder.

- Ben
